name: WehaveTrees
description:
🌲 Welcome to WeHaveTrees – Survival with a Fresh Twist! 🌲

✅ Java & Bedrock Support | 📌 IP: wehavetrees.gg | 🔗 Discord: discord.wehavetrees.gg

🌟 Featured Attractions

🚪 Visual Land Claiming – Protect your builds with an easy, intuitive system. 

🐾 Leash Any Mob – Even rare mobs can be leashed for ultimate customization! 

🪄 Magic Carpets – Soar above your builds on a magical glass platform. 

💰 Player-Run Shops – Build and manage your own thriving in-game business.

🌳 What Makes WeHaveTrees Unique?

🚪 Land Claiming & Protection

🔲 Chunk-Based Visual Claiming – See and claim your land with ease. 

➕ Easy Expansion – Grow your territory as you progress. 

🏷️ Claim Flags – Customize rules like PvP, mob spawning, and more!

🐾 Leash Any Mob

Move any mob, even rare ones, with a lead – perfect for collectors and builders!

💰 Community-Driven Economy & Shops

💎 Emerald-Based Economy – Trade and earn in a balanced system. 

🏪 Player-Run Market – Set up shops and compete in a bustling marketplace. 

🧑‍🌾 Trading Villagers – Fair trades with custom-balanced villagers.

✨ Custom Features & Quality-of-Life Additions

🪄 Magic Carpet Rentals – Fly while building for a unique experience! 

🎨 ArtMap Painting – Create pixel art in-game. 

😄 Chat Emojis – Spice up your chats with unlockable emojis. 

🚩 Advanced Claim Flags – Total control over your land’s settings. 

🪣 Infinite Water Bucket – Endless water for your builds. 

🧽 Everydry Sponge – Dry out areas instantly. 

🌾 Replanting Hoe Enchantment – Auto-replant crops. 

🔥 Molten Touch Pickaxe Enchantment – Smelt ores as you mine. 

📋 Community Board at Spawn – Advertise shops or services. 

🐾 Give Pets to Others – Share pets with /givepet . 

📦 Show Items in Chat – Display gear with [item] and [inventory].

⚡ NEW: mcMMO Skill System

🎯 Level up skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. 

💪 Earn abilities and perks as you play. 

🧱 Balanced to enhance survival gameplay.

🛡️ Resetting Resource Worlds
